I'd like to add two brief topics to the agenda pls:
- Wrapping up & verifying the KZG Ceremony
- A very brief overview of [RollCall](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/885)
I believe we'll have more CL data about block/blob receive times on the current devnet. If so, we should address it here

Not my EIP, but I would be interested in a temperature check of [EIP-7523](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7523), relating to empty accounts in tests.  Now that 4788 is settled this can be considered on it's merits.
